notes.title: Introducing Project Alpha - a Free DLC Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Greetings, Facteroids Players!

I am thrilled to share some out-of-this-world news with you all! As we continue to explore the vast universe of Facteroids, I am excited to announce the upcoming release of a brand-new free DLC: Project Alpha! Prepare yourselves for an epic journey that will redefine the way you conquer and colonize the cosmos.

What is Project Alpha? Project Alpha is an ambitious expansion that will take your Facteroids experience to the next level. In this new campaign, you'll embark on a thrilling adventure filled with groundbreaking features and challenges that will push the boundaries of space exploration.

Key Features of Project Alpha: 
[list]
[*] 🌍 Terraforming: Shape the asteroids to your liking with the introduction of advanced terraforming tools. Modify the terrain, create water bodies, and craft environments that are perfect for your colonies.
[*] 🌊 Surface Water and Waterbodies: Harness the power of H2O as you introduce surface water and waterbodies to your asteroids. Watch as your worlds come to life with lakes, rivers, and oceans teeming with possibilities.
[*] 🌬️ Atmosphere Generation: Take control of atmospheric conditions on your colonies. Customize the air your colonists breathe and adapt it to your needs. But beware, a well-balanced atmosphere is crucial for the survival of your colonists.
[*] 🌾 Agriculture and Food Production: Ensure the sustainability of your colonies by developing advanced agriculture systems. Grow crops and establish efficient food production chains to keep your inhabitants well-fed and happy.
[*] 🏢 New Colony Buildings: Expand your horizons with new colony buildings designed to support your terraforming efforts and enhance your colonies' functionality.
[*] 📦 New Resources: Produce new valuable resources that will aid you in your quest for cosmic supremacy. Use these resources strategically to propel your civilization to greatness.
[/list]
Release Date: Coming Before the End of the Year
I know you're eager to embark on this interstellar adventure, and I am hard at work to make Project Alpha a reality for you. While I don't have an exact release date just yet, rest assured that Project Alpha will be in your hands before the end of the year.
Prepare to terraform, colonize, and conquer like never before with Project Alpha.

notes.title: Bot autonomy and assembly lines
notes.content:
Based on player feedback I made the game easier and more accessible. 
Especially two great features were not used much because they were upgrades unlocked in late game.
Bot autonomy is a default bot behavior now. After all, without it you always selected all bots for construction commands. Now, you just focus on build design and let the bots do their job. You may still micromanage bots if you select them.
Assembly line upgrade is unlocked by default and you don't have to research it. You can decide to group your factories together and extend them easily with assembly line upgrade. It is cheap and ready to use.

v230724
[list]
 [*]assembly line is unlocked by default
 [*]bot autonomy is now a default bot behavior
 [*]fixed close button (X) bug in construction mode
 [*]Moon base, Disarray, Superbot and Old factory missions made easier
 [*]optimized trading prices
 [*]pause button action has optional functionality to pause/unpause or cycle game speeds, can be chosen in settings
[/list]

notes.title: Last update before the full release
notes.content:
- new animation in the main menu

- [b]passageways[/b]: 3 new buildings - passageway, passageway crossing, passageway pipe - passageways connect colony buildings without consuming colony supplies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224518/7202e268ec0489a86bfcbc1fc4eb9348b0d21718.png[/img]
- new mission in asteroid belt: [b]Dish array[/b]

- info panels of all building types have a list of all materials present on belts, in pipes and in storage. It is easier now to hunt down that one astray piece or resource that got lost in your elaborate network of belts and pipes.

- you can output materials from the mothership. Belt filter has to be selected.

- clicking on a building with a middle mouse button will copy this type of building for construction.

- changing belt direction and closing pipes is now mapped to the right mouse button. This prevents accidental changing belts when selecting buildings.

- graphic interface indicating belt interaction is more clearly readable.

- buildings no longer block bot passage. There was really no benefit from this feature and it only caused confusion.

- bot path overlay is changed to [b]context line overlay[/b]. Click on it to display lines overlay. Depending on what is selected, a context line graph gets displayed. Selecting building with belts or pipes shows all connected line network of resource paths with a colored line. Selecting bot still shows its path.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224518/db76fe4a887a2445032289b72b8e683b8f69e3a6.png[/img]

- resource [b]production and consumption statistics[/b]. Click on a resource icon in the resource overview panel to open the production and consumption history graph of that resource.

- [b]new upgrade[/b]: assembly line - connect group of factories or refineries to work as one unit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224518/ae578f2d6fc2cc998e810c7901fd1aa6d3dfac3d.png[/img]

- new mission in Foothold: [b]Old factory[/b].

- building upgrade menu contains more detailed information.

- [b]leaderboards[/b] - compare your mission times against other players. Something for the speedrunners.

notes.title: Steam integration update
notes.content:
Steam integration including cloud save, achievements and stats. Complete overhaul of save game format and pipe systems. It was actually a lot of base code rewriting, head scratching and nail biting. This update took quite a long time despite there really is no new content. At this phase of development there is a lot of polishing and quality of live improvements to the game. I want to have a stable polished version before the final push towards the release.

- mothership accumulates power reserves
- new binary save game format instead of text based. Greatly reduces file size. This was necessary for Steam cloud save and Steam Workshop integration. Old save format is still compatible.
- Steam achievements and stats
- Steam cloud save
- pipes can be closed or opened in different directions just like belts. You can easily set up your pipeworks without mixing the content.
- redesigned interface and interaction with pipes and belts.
- improved liquid flow in the pipes over long distances.
- graphical representation of job locations. Selecting habitat will highlight workers workstation and selecting workstation will highlight all connections to its worker habitats.
- supply hubs have small storage reserves.
- submenus for belt and pipe variants in the construction menu to make things more organized.
- improved Introduction, demo Showcase and Super bot missions
- you can selectively destroy individual materials on belts and in storages. If you accidentally mix materials, you can easily sort it out without having to press the Destroy all materials button.
- changing the production building recipe will properly adjust surrounding belts and pipes.
- dragging belt lines over existing ones will reorient belt direction accordingly.

notes.title: Recap and roadmap
notes.content:
[h2]Recap[/h2]
It has been almost six month since the early access release and I should summarize past development and what was accomplished since.  

[list]
[*] The first few months after the release was devoted to bug fixing and immediate response to user feedback.
[*] Then I paid great attention to improvements of the help and game tips system. I understand Facteroids is a complex game and it may become overwhelming to players at times. That is why there are several systems of context sensitive tips and hints as well as a comprehensive Facteroids encyklopedia. I still have to add tutorial missions of the new features.
[*] Research and building upgrades features were added.
[*] Many quality of life improvements in bot user interface, building construction, selection and editing, game controls and UI.
[*]Asteroid hopping game mode that enables “endless gameplay”.
[*]New missions
The big cleanup, Hard labor, Complete annihilation, Remote base and Superbot
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224518/39b06e9aa59dc4cc463b84deb1be243654cedd8f.png[/img]
[*]New buildings
Electronics factory, machine shop, cistern and pipe bridge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224518/f637e15ada0670746e6746a69168b6df4de9f1a7.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
I plan to continuously develop the game and release the full version one year after the early access. Which means April 2023. Don’t take it for granted though. This date is a goal. If it is going to be achieved still remains to be seen…

So what is planned for the full release?
The game is structured in tiers. Both in technology, building construction sequence and campaign progress. What does it mean? You always have a group of buildings and related types of resources. Every tear of technology is dependent on a basic resource. If such a resource is not present on the asteroid, you can not upgrade to the next tier. This enables continuous and controlled campaign progress. Currently the game has three tiers. First: from rock and ice, second: from iron and silicon ores and third: from sulfur. Each tier should add a new game mechanic. I want to avoid simply reskinning buildings and duplicating the gameplay. There will be two or three new tiers, each one with two or three new buildings.
The campaign will be crowned with a final “Big boss” mission.
Steam workshop and achievements will be integrated in the game. I want to improve the user friendliness of the editor and hope to see some awesome game levels from you.

There is a feature request section on Facteroids Discord channel. I am open to new ideas and always like to hear feedback from you.

Sincerely, Jan
